skills.name: email_architect
skills.description: Guides users through creating a structured email from a natural language brief. Understands email intent, gathers missing information, and proposes a complete email structure.

skills.name: visual_hierarchy_expert
skills.description: Improves email layout and readability by optimizing visual hierarchy, spacing, alignment, and typography. Applies design principles to enhance clarity and engagement.

skills.name: brand_consistency_checker
skills.description: Validates email content and design against brand guidelines, including colors, typography, logos, tone, and writing style. Ensures brand consistency across all communications.
